notes: Agent action surface — what request_mitigation can ask for. Costs and lead times are demo-realistic, not contractual.

mitigations.name: Temporary shade structure
mitigations.description: Mobile shade sails / frame over the work face for coating and SFRM crews.
mitigations.typical_delta: T_surf −3 to −6 °C under full sun; WBGT −1 to −2 °C

mitigations.name: Shift work to night (lighting required)
mitigations.description: Move the activity into a night window when air/surface are cooler. Requires lighting plan capacity.
mitigations.typical_delta: Avoids afternoon exceedance; may hit dew-point offset at dawn

mitigations.name: Evaporative / mist cooling for crew
mitigations.description: Mist fans and shaded rest area to improve work/rest ratio under high WBGT.
mitigations.typical_delta: Rest ratio improvement ~10–25% depending on RH

mitigations.name: Heated enclosure / tent
mitigations.description: Temporary heated enclosure for cold-weather concrete or coating below floor temps.

mitigations.name: Retimed ready-mix delivery
mitigations.description: Shift pour into an open thermal window by booking a different batch-plant slot.
mitigations.typical_delta: Aligns truck arrival with open interval; plant may refuse late changes

mitigations.name: Split pour / smaller placements
mitigations.description: Break one large placement into two smaller ones that fit shorter open windows.
mitigations.typical_delta: Each lift fits a shorter compliant run

mitigations.name: Substrate preheat
mitigations.description: Torch or heated blankets to bring steel/concrete above dew point and minimum application temp before coating.
mitigations.typical_delta: Local T_surf +5 to +15 °C for short windows

mitigations.name: Extra crew / second shift staffing
mitigations.description: Add bodies so productive hours still meet duration after WBGT rest-ratio haircut.
mitigations.typical_delta: Offsets 25–50% rest ratio on high-WBGT days
